Priya: Launch update 1: BurstStream Relay is GA for Hosted API. It's designed for bursty, fan-out workloads (live Q&A, multi-tool pipelines). Opt-in via Console -> Endpoints now. :tada:

Ben: Congrats! Does Relay change routing semantics?

Priya: Yes 6 Relay introduces session-level affinity and multiplexed upstream connections. It can fan-out to multiple model variants concurrently and stitch partial results.

Carlos: Any new config options we should call out for customers?

Priya: Key params: `relay_mode` (sequential|parallel), `fanout_factor` (1-8), and `stitch_threshold_ms` (defaults to 50). Theres also a `partial_commit` flag that lets you stream early partials while waiting for long-running tools.

Maya: Ops note 6 scheduling a short canary window. I added a failover policy to the runbook and synthetic checks for stitched outputs.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollout/burststream-relay: initiated (canary clusters: us-east-2) at 2765432150. canary_replicas=2.

Ben: SDK/new-client impact? Anything shipping that will break existing consumers?

Priya: Non-breaking patch releases for SDKs. New streaming frames include `frame_kind` ("partial"|"stitch"|"final"). We added helpers: `relay.collect_stitches()` in py/js. Existing streaming calls still work unchanged.

Carlos: Billing model?

Priya: Relay billing counts `fanout_units` = requests * fanout_factor + stitch_bytes. Default quota: 10 rps, 1000 fanout_units/min. Customers can request increases in Console.

Maya: infra bot update: deploy-bot: rollout/burststream-relay: canary health=ok (2765432205). Proceeding to broader rollout in 2 hours.

Ben: Any deprecations?

Priya: No outright deprecations tied to Relay, but we will recommend Relay over the older `multiplex` preview. `multiplex` will be deprecated in 60 days; migration guide linked below.

Priya: Docs: https://console.redwood.ai/docs/burststream-relay-migration and a short migration script in the examples repo.

Carlos: Example curl for the docs: 

Carlos: ```bash
Carlos: curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
Carlos:   -d '{"model":"relay-small-1","relay_mode":"parallel","fanout_factor":3,"partial_commit":true}' \
Carlos:   https://api.redwood.ai/v1/burst/relay/stream
Carlos: ```
